home.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer | Product & Systems
home.footer: Website now translated & avaliable in 100+ languages!
home.descriptionA: Senior full-stack engineer with 6+ years of experience taking products from ambiguous requirements to reliable production systems. I design the architecture behind React, Angular, .NET, Node.js, Java, C#, Go, and SQL applications: clear service boundaries, durable data models, secure access patterns, and delivery paths teams can operate with confidence.
home.descriptionB: My work connects engineering decisions to business outcomes. From a construction-estimating SaaS that turns spreadsheet data into client-ready proposals to revenue-generating web platforms, I build software around the workflow, risk, and measurable value that matter to the people using it.

personal_summary.title: Personal Summary
personal_summary.text: I am a senior full-stack engineer based in Orlando, FL who owns the path from product problem to production outcome. I make technology choices in service of the system: .NET and Entity Framework Core when a strongly structured domain and testable persistence matter; Angular or React when complex workflows need a maintainable interface; Node.js or Go when an API, integration, or high-performance tool needs a focused runtime. Across SaaS products, internal workflows, and customer-facing platforms, I lead with explicit tradeoffs, secure and resilient design, automated testing, and delivery practices that help teams ship valuable software without leaving operational debt behind.

entries.title: Full Stack Engineering
entries.text: I lead end-to-end product delivery: translating business workflows into system boundaries, data models, APIs, and interfaces, then carrying the work through testing, deployment, and iteration. The goal is software that a team can evolve and operate, not a collection of disconnected screens.

entries.title: Product & Platform Architecture
entries.text: I choose platforms and patterns based on the problem: layered .NET services for business domains, component-driven Angular or React applications for complex operations, relational data models for accountable workflows, and integrations designed with failure modes, access control, and maintainability in mind.

entries.title: Production-Ready Delivery
entries.text: I build with the realities after launch in view: secrets kept out of source control, explicit database migration paths, role-based authorization, validation at system boundaries, automated tests, CI/CD awareness, and practical observability. These are the details that turn a prototype into dependable software.

biblioteca.title: Biblioteca JSON
biblioteca.text: A Python-based localization pipeline that turns one structured content source into a globally accessible portfolio. It handles translation data as a maintainable system rather than manually duplicated page copy, allowing the site to scale across 100+ languages and making global reach an operational capability instead of a one-time feature.

connect_four.title: Connect Four
connect_four.text: Massive family of over 50+ implementations of the Connect Four game. This project includes implementations in over 30 different programming languages, including Java, C++, Python, JavaScript, and more. Additionally, it also includes over 20+ different frameworks or other formats, including React.js, Ruby on Rails, ASP.NET, and more.

grocery_app.title: Grocery App
grocery_app.text: A full-stack .NET 9 Blazor Server application that demonstrates intentional backend architecture for a business workflow. The controller/service/repository split keeps application rules, data access, and presentation independently testable; Entity Framework Core provides durable persistence; and the comprehensive test suite protects behavior as the product evolves.

interop.title: Interop Project
interop.text: A cross-language interoperability reference spanning 15 programming languages and 18 execution patterns. The project investigates the boundary where systems often become fragile: process contracts, data exchange, runtime behavior, and repeatable integration paths. It reflects the systems thinking needed when a product is larger than a single stack.

inventory_register.title: Inventory Register
inventory_register.text: A full-stack POS and inventory workflow built with Angular 17+ and Node.js. It models the operational concerns of a B2B system: authenticated users, role-based access control, inventory accuracy, and a mock payment flow. The project is designed around the actual work a register team performs, not just a catalog of framework features.

formatter.title: JSON & YAML Auto Formatter
formatter.text: A browser-based JSON and YAML validation and formatting tool built in Go and compiled to WebAssembly. Moving the parsing engine into WASM keeps the interaction responsive and local to the browser while applying a real parser to catch invalid input. It is a focused example of choosing a runtime architecture for performance, portability, and user trust.

takeoff_engine.title: Takeoff Engine
takeoff_engine.text: A construction estimating SaaS built around a costly, error-prone contractor workflow. The React + Express product ingests CSV and Excel data, maps inconsistent columns into a usable domain model, calculates trench excavation and earthwork volumes, tracks labor and markup, and produces client-ready PDF and Word proposals. This is full product lifecycle engineering: data parsing, calculation rules, a polished operator workflow, and deliverables that help a business move from raw inputs to a bid.

minecraft_json_generator.title: Minecraft JSON Generator
minecraft_json_generator.text: Lightweight JSON generator built in Python for Minecraft resource & data packs. This project is used to generate JSON files for Minecraft mods, including custom items, blocks, and entities. Very useful for not only creating custom datapacks, but for mods as well via the mod name switching feature.

educational_experience.title: My Educational Experience
educational_experience.text: Alongside my personal projects, I also have acquired numerous skills from educational experience. Click here to view my LinkedIn profile for more information.

professional_experience.title: My Professional Experience
professional_experience.text: Six-plus years of professional engineering experience across product teams, business platforms, and customer-facing software. My work has included building maintainable application layers, collaborating across delivery disciplines, and making technical decisions with the product lifecycle, operational risk, and long-term ownership in view.

portfolio_website.title: Patrick Goodwin Portfolio Website
portfolio_website.text: A production-minded React portfolio that treats accessibility and global reach as engineering requirements. It includes a maintainable translation pipeline for 100+ languages, interactive tools backed by WebAssembly, responsive and accessible UI patterns, and a project architecture designed to grow as new work is shipped.

lua_library.title: Patrick's Lua Script Library
lua_library.text: A useful library of Lua scripts for future reference. This library is used to automate tasks in Lua scripts, which can come in handy for performance-needy tasks, as Lua is usually a faster scripting language than both Python and Ruby.

excel_scripts.title: Patrick's Microsoft Excel Spreadsheet Scripts (VBA)
excel_scripts.text: A useful library of VBA scripts for Microsoft Excel. This library is used to automate tasks in Excel spreadsheets.

neovim_config.title: Patrick's Neovim Config
neovim_config.text: My personal Neovim configuration. This project is used to configure Neovim to my liking, including custom keybindings, themes, and plugins. This project is used to make Neovim more user-friendly and efficient for my personal use.

python_maps.title: Patrick's Map Generator
python_maps.text: A Python geospatial reporting tool built with GeoPandas and Matplotlib to generate U.S. county and state maps. It turns geographic data into readable analysis artifacts, demonstrating a data pipeline mindset: select the right domain libraries, normalize inputs, and produce outputs that support clear decisions.

powershell_library.title: Patrick's PowerShell Script Library
powershell_library.text: A useful library of PowerShell scripts for future reference. Useful with the $profile script feature, I find this immensely helpful for automating tasks from the Windows terminal, as I am a frequent user of the Windows OS.

ruby_library.title: Patrick's Ruby Script Library
ruby_library.text: A useful library of Ruby scripts for future reference. Useful for future Ruby on Rails developmental concepts.

pdf_builder.title: PDF Skills Builder
pdf_builder.text: A document-generation workflow built with Python, Pdfkit, Jinja2, HTML, and structured JSON data. It separates reusable data from presentation templates to generate tailored PDF resumes consistently, a practical pattern for reducing manual work and making business documents repeatable.

rijandel_encryption.title: Rijandel Encryption Project
rijandel_encryption.text: A comparative set of 10+ Rijndael implementations across 128-, 192-, and 256-bit variants. Reimplementing a security-sensitive algorithm across languages is a disciplined exercise in exact specifications, testable behavior, and the limits of language-level portability, all useful instincts for systems that handle sensitive data.

suprememc.title: SupremeMC Minecraft Mod
suprememc.text: A Minecraft Mod that adds custom tools, armor, mobs, blocks, dimensions, and many more features to the game. Built with Java versions 8-17 for select Minecraft versions between 1.16 and 1.20.

tiger_programming_language.title: Tiger Programming Language
tiger_programming_language.text: A custom programming language and interpreter built in Go to explore language runtime design, execution behavior, and performance tradeoffs. Compiling it to WebAssembly and integrating it into the portfolio creates a real, inspectable product surface for systems-level engineering rather than leaving the work as a repository-only experiment.

tiger_tailgating_pros.title: Tiger Tailgating Pros Website
tiger_tailgating_pros.text: A React website delivered for a Clemson, SC tailgating business. The work translates a small business's offering into a clear customer journey and dependable web presence, applying product thinking to help a real organization convert interest into inquiries and revenue.

turing_machine.title: Turing Machine Project
turing_machine.text: Family of over 30+ implementations of the Turing Machine. Used to demonstrate turing completeness for different programming languages for research, especially for the Tiger Programming Language.

contact.title: Contact Me
contact.description: I respond to inquires from email and LinkedIn messages. I also will call back if my number is provided via resume or otherwise, though I prefer to keep my phone number private.

formatter.title: JSON & YAML Linter
formatter.description: A browser-based data quality tool that validates and formats JSON and YAML using a Go engine compiled to WebAssembly. The architecture keeps parsing close to the user for fast, private feedback while enforcing real syntax rules at the data boundary. It is a compact example of designing a dependable developer workflow around correctness, performance, and trust.

tiger.title: Tiger Language
tiger.description: Tiger is a custom programming language and Go interpreter built to explore runtime architecture, language semantics, and performance tradeoffs. Compiling the interpreter to WebAssembly turns that systems work into an interactive, browser-based product: users can execute programs directly while the runtime remains portable and isolated from the host application.
